theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_lipschitz_smooth_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (u : Rn N → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K u → HasCompactSupport u → ∃ v : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (v j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (v j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (v j) ⊆ Metric.cthickening (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) (tsupport u)) ∧ (∀ j y, ‖fderiv ℝ (v j) y‖ ≤ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly v u atTop ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ fderiv ℝ (v j) y) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ u y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
